detailed_descriptions.en: Kill the competition in this thrilling, 6v6 indoor volleyball game, built for players craving all the fast paced action and strategic depth the sport has to offer! Killer Aces Volleyball emphasizes fun-first gameplay, blending arcade style excitement with realistic volleyball mechanics. Streamlined controls are intuitive for new players while offering the layered, strategic depth savvy veterans will need to dominate from pin to pin! Utilize a variety of gameplay sliders and options to perfectly tune the challenge you'll face on the court or watching comfortably from the sidelines in Spectator mode. Got a second controller on hand? Team up with a friend and put your relationship to the test in a head to head, local multiplayer battle! Early Access Features 18 Men's and Women's national teams - a full range of competitors to choose from! Women's teams play differently than the men's with a slightly slower pace, longer rallies, and slide attacks Tournament Mode - deep tournament with pool and bracket play, complete stat tracking, and end of tournament awards. Play or sim any game on the schedule and customize format options like points to win, number of sets, and more Gameplay sliders - tweak and tune your volleyball experience to play how you want it Coach's challenge - think that spike was actually in? Let's watch the replay and see what the ref missed! Planned Features for 1.0 Launch (in progress) National Team Mode - develop and manage your country's players over multiple seasons to compete in yearly tournaments and prepare to win gold at the world championship every 4 years Full player customization - adjust their personal information, appearance, ratings, and gear to build your dream roster Additional national teams to be added in the future!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Kill the competition in this thrilling, 6v6 indoor volleyball game, built for players craving all the fast paced action and strategic depth the sport has to offer!

Killer Aces Volleyball emphasizes fun-first gameplay, blending arcade style excitement with realistic volleyball mechanics. Streamlined controls are intuitive for new players while offering the layered, strategic depth savvy veterans will need to dominate from pin to pin! Utilize a variety of gameplay sliders and options to perfectly tune the challenge you'll face on the court or watching comfortably from the sidelines in Spectator mode. Got a second controller on hand? Team up with a friend and put your relationship to the test in a head to head, local multiplayer battle!

Early Access Features

  • 18 Men's and Women's national teams - a full range of competitors to choose from! Women's teams play differently than the men's with a slightly slower pace, longer rallies, and slide attacks

  • Tournament Mode - deep tournament with pool and bracket play, complete stat tracking, and end of tournament awards. Play or sim any game on the schedule and customize format options like points to win, number of sets, and more

  • Gameplay sliders - tweak and tune your volleyball experience to play how you want it

  • Coach's challenge - think that spike was actually in? Let's watch the replay and see what the ref missed!

Planned Features for 1.0 Launch (in progress)

  • National Team Mode - develop and manage your country's players over multiple seasons to compete in yearly tournaments and prepare to win gold at the world championship every 4 years

  • Full player customization - adjust their personal information, appearance, ratings, and gear to build your dream roster

  • Additional national teams to be added in the future!
